title: The Cone Line
hook: Orange starts a long way out.
scene: Orange starts a long way out. The cones walk left across the right lane ahead of you and there are two people in hi-viz past the taper.
decision: The cones are walking left. What do you do?

options.text: Move over early and take the posted speed
options.result: You take the shift while the cones are still a line, not a wall. The number comes down. The two in hi-viz stay on their feet. You are in the lane they left you before the pinch finished.

options.text: Hold speed until the cones force you over
options.result: You keep the leftover until the taper is a wall. Then you have to take it late, next to people on foot. The cones already asked. You made them force it.

options.text: Brake hard at the taper and squeeze in
options.result: You stand on it at the pinch and cut in. The car behind you still has leftover. One yellow coat has to move. The posted number was a long way out.

debrief: Reduce your speed to the posted work zone limit and move over early. Fines double and workers are on foot past the taper.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one
source.teaching_target: Reduce speed to the posted work zone limit and move over early. Fines double; workers are on foot past the taper.
